<p><time datetime="2026-08-14">2026-08-14</time> – <time datetime="2026-08-16">2026-08-16</time></p>
<p>Returning to Bolinas, a place that resonated so deeply with me during my three months in California, and sharing it with some of great folks. It ended up being an unexpectedly reflective adventure.</p>

<figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-1.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: The boys. One of my oldest and newest friends. What a cool moment"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-1.jpg" alt="The boys. One of my oldest and newest friends. What a cool moment" loading="lazy"></a><figcaption>The boys. One of my oldest and newest friends. What a cool moment</figcaption></figure>

<p>After three months doing field work and research on Coast Redwoods in the Santa Cruz area, the last weekend needed to be intentional, relaxing, and reflective. Alex and I had been mulling over how we were gonna approach it. It wasn&#39;t &#39;til a few days before that we got the plan together. But, the framework was always there and had to consist of the following: surf, bike, loose checkpoints with lots of &quot;go-with-the-flow&quot; moments of exploration, and most importantly, MOG.</p>

<h2>Friday 08/14</h2>

<p>But first, let&#39;s surf...</p>

<section class="adventure-gallery adventure-row" aria-label="Photo row"><div class="gallery-track"><figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-2.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Photo"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-2.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></a></figure><figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-3.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Photo"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-3.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></a></figure></div><p>One last morning rip at Pleasure Point. This place became my afterwork place of solitude and release. I had had a fantastic sunset surf the day before, chopping it up with a bunch of lads at sewer&#39;s point and dropping into some big sets, and combined with this session, with the Ham&#39;s made for a perfect finish to my time in Santa Cruz.</p></section>

<p>It ended up being a late start getting out of Santa Cruz towards Marin (a combination of time spent at the mechanics, packing, lunch etc). But we were soon on the road with boards strapped to the top and bikes hanging off the back. Sean gave us a call as we were driving up and said his neck was finally healed enough to get at it with us. Fuak yeaa</p>

<figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-4.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Crossing the golden gate heading to Marin headlands. Reminder as I&#39;m writing this, I haven&#39;t paid off my GG bridge toll fees yet (it&#39;s October now)"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-4.jpg" alt="Crossing the golden gate heading to Marin headlands. Reminder as I&#39;m writing this, I haven&#39;t paid off my GG bridge toll fees yet (it&#39;s October now)" loading="lazy"></a><figcaption>Crossing the golden gate heading to Marin headlands. Reminder as I&#39;m writing this, I haven&#39;t paid off my GG bridge toll fees yet (it&#39;s October now)</figcaption></figure>

<p>We decided to pull off at the headlands and get the bikes off. Figured we see what was going on, especially after Anna Winter, a friend and legend from the NASA DEVELOP program, had spoken so highly of it. It was a little drizzly, as expected, but what a stunning ride - way better than we had imagined. And good lord, the roads were paved so wonderfully.</p>
<p>We hurried to Olema campgrounds quickly after, met up with Sean, slammed some Kirins, and grilled some steak and lamb chops. Mega.</p>

<h2>Day 2 09/16</h2>

<p>An early start to Bolinas. Hopped into the water by 7 to a quiet line up. The waves in this town aren&#39;t the best but it&#39;s fun, you surf to a view of redwood forests in the distance and fog swirling low around you. It&#39;s like you&#39;re in Jurassic Park.</p>

<section class="adventure-gallery adventure-row" aria-label="Photo row"><div class="gallery-track"><figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-8.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Photo"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-8.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></a></figure><figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-9.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Photo"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-9.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></a></figure><figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-10.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Photo"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-10.jpg" alt="" loading="lazy"></a></figure></div><p>Sweet surf sesh, chatted to some locals after (they&#39;ll come back up in the story)</p></section>

<p>We ended back in town, of course had to stop by Buzz&#39;s to pick up some T-shirts (ask me about the legend of Buzz), and found some ribs and freshly baked sourdough in the local mart. The early afternoon was filled with lying on grass back at camp, sipping cold Rose, and chain smoking fags.</p>
<p>Soon after, hunger struck again and we knew that there were oysters up north in the Point Reyes bay to be had. After trying and failing to get some at Hog Island oysters (crazy wait), we stopped by a local seller. Unfortunately, they would not shuck for you and wouldn&#39;t let you have the oysters there.</p>

<figure><a class="adventure-photo" href="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-11.jpg" aria-label="Expand photo: Aforementioned ribs and fresh sourdough (still warm to the touch!)"><img src="/images/adventures/2026-08-14-marin-bolinas-and-the-north-bay-the-last-weekend-in-california-cbb704d2/cbb704d2-11.jpg" alt="Aforementioned ribs and fresh sourdough (still warm to the touch!)" loading="lazy"></a><figcaption>Aforementioned ribs and fresh sourdough (still warm to the touch!)</figcaption></figure>

<p>After bidding Sean adieu (for now), Alex and I debated going on a bike ride. We ended up deciding to go to mass at the local church for Alex to do his weekend duties before cycling </p>
